description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - The Sri Lanka Electricity Act No. 20 of 2009 (Amended) Issuance of Certificate  of Exemption
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under Section 10(3) of The Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended). It involves the issuance of certificates of exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution and supply, which constitutes regulatory action and the implementation of statutory powers under existing legislation. This falls squarely within the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments.
